newsitem.title: FINLAND: NOKIA WINS ORDER FROM CHINA RAILWAYS.
newsitem.headline: NOKIA WINS ORDER FROM CHINA RAILWAYS.

text.p: Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it had won an optical transmission system order from China Railways.
Nokia did not give the price of the deal.
"This latest project strengthens Nokia's relationship with one of the world's most rapidly expanding railway operators," Nokia said.

The optical transmission network, to be delivered by Nokia's Telecommunications unit, will span almost 900 kilometres and provision both SDH (Synchronous Digital Hierarchy) and PDH (Plesiochronous Digital Hierarchy) systems.
The network will be installed on the the newly constructed Nanning to Kunming railway in the southern provinces of Yunnan and Guangxi, Nokia said.
Nokia has been supplying digital switching, transmission and management systems to China Railways for almost 10 years.
